title.en: The rivalry they printed for you

summary.en: Newspapers draw a fight. Fans buy jerseys. Both bands sell more records. History gets a cartoon.
summary.zh: 报纸画一场架。粉丝买球衣。两队唱片都更好卖。历史多了一幅漫画。

body.en:
Beatles vs Stones. Oasis vs Blur. Sometimes the dislike is real—egos are flammable. Often it's a useful cartoon: two brands, one headline, infinite bar arguments.

Rivalries flatten scenes into sports brackets. Fun for a night. Terrible as your whole taste. Ride the Timeline and listen to both sides; the gossip is seasoning, not the meal.
body.zh:
Beatles 对 Stones。Oasis 对 Blur。有时讨厌是真的——自我易燃。更多时候是好用的漫画：两个品牌，一个标题，酒吧里吵到天亮。

对决把场景压成体育对阵表。玩一晚很爽；当全部品味很糟。去 Timeline 两边都听；八卦是调料，不是主菜。

note.en: The other half, still touring the punchline.
note.zh: 另一半，还在巡演那句笑点。
